answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens and form an interconnected graph. Game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across clusters: an auditor swoops down like a falcon to identify sparse bottlenecks where clones attempt to bridge the ocean of genuine interactions. If fraudulent coordination is detected, automated stake slashing plunges the colluding identities' reserves to their nadir, imposing a superlinear attacker cost that scales with cluster density.
